purpose: Reproducible, non-zero, norm-controlled low-rank deltas whose effect W' = W + scale * (lora_alpha / r) * B @ A is computed independently by lora_reference.py.
generator: sd3_lora_synth.py (numpy only; no torch, no engine code)
module_shapes: sd3m_dit_linear_shapes.json (read from the pinned checkpoint's header)

values.rng: splitmix64 over a per-(namespace, adapter, module, matrix) 64-bit key = the first 8 bytes of sha256('<rng_namespace>|<adapter>|<module>|<A or B>|<seed>'), counter = element index in row-major order; rng_namespace fixes the random stream independently of adapter strength
values.A: A[i, j] = v * 2^-a_exp (a_exp fixed per adapter)
values.B: B[i, j] = v * 2^-b_exp(module), b_exp the integer that brings the module's RMS of (lora_alpha / r) * B @ A closest to 2^delta_rms_log2 in log2 -- so the achieved RMS is within a factor sqrt(2) of the target, by construction
values.exactness: every A and B entry is a 7-bit integer times a power of two: exactly representable in bfloat16, float16 and float32, so the file's BF16 storage loses nothing and every consumer reads the same numbers

format.keys: transformer.<module>.lora_A.weight [r, in_features] and transformer.<module>.lora_B.weight [out_features, r], BF16
format.metadata: {"format": "pt", "lora_adapter_metadata": JSON of {transformer.r, transformer.lora_alpha, transformer.target_modules, transformer.rank_pattern, transformer.alpha_pattern, transformer.use_dora, transformer.lora_bias}} -- the key diffusers' write_lora_layers / _load_sft_state_dict_metadata use, and the keys its get_peft_kwargs emits (diffusers 0.37 _create_lora_config reads rank_pattern unconditionally when metadata is present)
format.semantics: delta(module) = scale * (lora_alpha / r) * (B @ A), added to the module's weight [out, in]; scale = 0 or disabled means exactly the base weight
format.target_rules: each rule names an inclusive block range and module kinds; the module is transformer_blocks.<i>.<kind>. absent=skip: a module the checkpoint does not have is left out (to_add_out in block 23, which is context_pre_only); absent=error: the generator refuses
format.v4_fields: use_rslora (the delta is scale * lora_alpha / sqrt(r) * B @ A, and metadata transformer.use_rslora true), alpha_pattern (peft's per-module lora_alpha, metadata transformer.alpha_pattern), variant dora / lora_bias (files the engine must refuse)

design_notes.alpha_over_r: A: 16/8 = 2, B: 8/16 = 0.5 -- both != 1, so an implementation that drops alpha/r is off by 2x or 0.5x, and one that inverts it is off by 4x on both
design_notes.target_sets: A covers image-stream AND context-stream attention in every block plus the image FFN in blocks 0-11; B covers a subset of both streams' attention plus the context FFN in blocks 12-22 (block 23 has no ff_context: context_pre_only). A\B (to_k, to_out.0, add_q_proj, add_v_proj, ff.* 0-11) must return to base when switching A -> B; B\A (ff_context.* 12-22) must appear only under B: that is what makes adapter state leaking across requests visible
design_notes.norm: Each adapter targets RMS(delta) = 2^delta_rms_log2 per module; the achieved per-module RMS is written to the manifest

v4.C: rsLoRA (peft use_rslora): r 16, lora_alpha 16, so alpha / sqrt(r) = 4 where alpha / r = 1 -- an engine that ignores the flag serves C at a quarter. Image-stream attention in every block (shared with A) plus the context FFN in blocks 12-22 (C only, like B), so A + C has shared layers and layers only C touches
v4.D: a DoRA file (a lora_magnitude_vector per module, use_dora in the metadata) on A's attention set: the engine must refuse it before any weight changes
v4.E: alpha_pattern: lora_alpha 8 = r (scaling 1) with to_q / to_k / to_v overridden to 32 (scaling 4); B is sized for each module's own alpha, so dropping the pattern serves those modules at a quarter
v4.F: a LoRA with a bias on B (lora_B.bias per module, lora_bias in the metadata): refused like D
v4.strength: Every adapter targets delta_rms_log2 -6 per module, with its own scaling convention

expected.measured: Expected deterministic file and tensor-set hashes for this recipe and the pinned checkpoint shapes
